[Section] Acknowledgments
[source_id=33] We thank Yoav Goldberg and Yoav Artzi, for their advice and comments. We thank the ONLP team at the Open University of Israel, for fruitful discussions throughout the process. We further thank the anonymous reviewers for their helpful comments. This research was presented at Georgetown University, Cornell University, and Tel-Aviv University. This research is supported by European Research Council, ERC-StG-2015 scheme, Grant number 677352, and by the Israel Science Foundation (ISF), Grant number 1739/26, for which we are grateful.
